verdict.rationale: Docs describe scale-to-zero after 5s of inactivity and fast resume (blaxel-docs-2), implying sandboxes only consume compute while active, which is suggestive of fine-grained usage-based billing, but no evidence explicitly states a per-second pricing/billing model or shows pricing pages confirming this granularity. missing for 10: explicit pricing/billing documentation stating per-second metering, evidence of actual invoicing granularity, independent confirmation of cost savings from scale-to-zero.
